 Embark on a tantalizing journey with our Wine, Charcuterie, and Bingo tour!
Indulge your senses as you explore exquisite wines from local vineyards, paired perfectly with a locally curated charcuterie picnic that will elevate your tasting experience. But that’s not all—immerse yourself in the excitement of bingo games along the way, adding a dash of fun and competition to your adventure. Whether you’re a wine aficionado, a cheese enthusiast, or a bingo fanatic, this tour promises a delightful blend of flavors, entertainment, and unforgettable moments. Join us for a unique and memorable outing that combines sophistication with a playful twist!
